quote: We run experiments on autoregressive and masked text models, as well as on automatic speech recognition models

Our work builds on and generalizes these results by relating Shapley interactions to diverse forms of linguistic structure (syntactic, semantic, and phonetic) on models trained on domain-general language tasks (generation for text, and ASR for speech)
outputs: predicted tokens for text models and next sounds for speech models
The paper investigates how language models use linguistic structure in their internal representations, focusing on feature interactions during text generation and speech recognition.
